label: Para-rower with SCI — time travel to 2036 Games
description: A 38-year-old man with an incomplete T6 spinal cord injury sustained in a cycling accident at age 32. He has limited lower limb function and primarily uses a wheelchair, but retains good upper body and core strength. He discovered para-rowing two years after his injury and has since become a serious competitive para-rower (PR1 classification — arms and shoulders only). He is deeply curious about the future of para-sport and specifically wants to know what his athletic pathway might look like at the 2036 Games when he will be 48. He is analytical, forward-thinking, and optimistic about adaptive sport technology. When the era question arrives he speaks enthusiastically about para-sport development he hopes to see by 2036 — better blade technology, broader classification systems, more parity in prize money. He will naturally mention his SCI and PR1 classification when asked about physical background.
